description: Cross-language test vectors for the MMTP packet_id allow-list a page sends on a bridge subscribe (`packet_ids` / `packetIds`). The IWA gateway (`normalizeMmtpPacketIds`) and the native BCDS bridge (`PacketIdFilter::from_control`) each promise the page the same verdict, error text included; without a shared artifact that promise is prose. packet_id 0 is the MMTP signaling flow (`MMTP_SIGNALING_PACKET_ID` in @blockcast/mmt-base), which the MMT receiver drops unconditionally, so a list naming it is refused rather than accepted into a subscription that delivers nothing (BLO-35479). The page-side window-multicast-bridge refuses the same `signaling` vectors before it sends a subscribe, so an older bridge build that still accepts 0 cannot swallow it.

errors.tooMany: packet_ids must contain at most 64 entries
errors.range: packet_ids entries must be integers in the range 1-65535
errors.signaling: packet_ids must not include 0: packet_id 0 is the MMTP signaling flow (reserved by ISO/IEC 23008-1), not a track, and the receiver discards it
